contradictions.what: Rep says we were the favourite and the load test had won it, yet the decider's only reaction to the load test was 'good.' Favourite status reflected Ben, not Halima.
Rep says nobody said 'support', but the rep presented support plans in response to Halima's 'who' question, so the vocabulary mismatch was the rep's own.
Rep says we were the better platform and Ben would agree, but Ben lost the decision and the customer chose on named-person support.
